task.title: M4: Graph renders correctly from module-level edges alone
task.description:
Make the graph view (and the shared graph model used later by compare) correct when a snapshot carries only edges with level 'module' and modules of kind package, namespace, or crate rather than file-level edges and dir modules. This is the fourth extensibility seam and what the Go adapter will produce. Build a synthetic snapshot fixture with package modules and module-level edges and drive the view from it.

Acceptance criteria:
- A synthetic snapshot with modules[].kind = 'package' and edges[].level = 'module' renders as a graph of packages with no file nodes and no errors.
- Mixed snapshots (file-level TS edges plus module-level Go edges) render both without duplicating or dropping edges.
- Collapse/expand, cycle detection, and tooltips all work on module-only graphs.
- The synthetic fixture is committed and used in an automated UI test (component-level or headless browser).
